theme.name: Soft Corporate Utility
theme.description: A refined blend of Swiss High-Contrast authority and Soft Utility approachability. Designed for high-trust corporate environments where clarity and data accuracy are paramount, yet the experience feels modern, frictionless, and premium. Avoids generic SaaS templates.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all functional data, forms, and tables. Clean and highly legible.

layouts.general: Multi-step progressive disclosure. Implement a vertical stepper on the left (desktop) and content on the right, keeping navigation predictable. Maintain generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) for breathing room.
layouts.bento_grid: For review and summary screens, use asymmetric bento grid layouts. Sub-grids for data density. Provide clear visual grouping for Outbound, Return, Hotel, and Transport segments.
layouts.forms: Use cardless flat forms with crisp 1px borders or very subtle radii (rounded-lg). Never center-align form inputs; left-align everything for scannability.

components.stepper: Visual progress indicator indicating steps: Berangkat (Outbound), Pulang (Return), Hotel, Transportasi (Transport), Review.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Use free-text inputs for 'Asal' and 'Tujuan' in the Transport section (DO NOT use dropdowns). Include a 'Tambah' (Add) button.
components.file_upload: Custom styled dropzone/upload area for 'Bukti' (Proofs). Must clearly show upload status for each specific item (tiket pp, transport, hotel).
components.cards: Subtle shadows only on hover (shadow-sm to shadow-md transition). Normal state uses 1px border (#E2E8F0) with no shadow.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with interactive micro-animations (scale-95 on active, hover color shifts).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Solid Backgrounds with crisp borders for data clarity. Avoid glassmorphism for critical form sections to prevent readability issues.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Use Tailwind spacing scale generously. E.g., gap-8 between major form sections, p-6 inside summary cards.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use the provided abstract corporate images to make empty states look premium.

motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for step transitions (fade in, slide slightly from right to left).
motion.micro_interactions: Add smooth hover states to buttons and form inputs (ring focus). Do NOT use generic 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-transport-btn', data-testid='upload-proof-outbound').

corporate_abstract.description: Silhouette in airport. Use for hero banners, login background, or empty state illustrations.

flight_window.description: Airplane window view. Use as a header image or visual accent for the 'Berangkat' / 'Pulang' ticket selection sections.

map_route.description: Map view. Use as a background accent or illustrative element in the 'Transportasi' step.

flow_requirements: Step 4: Transport. MUST use free-text inputs for 'Asal' (Origin) and 'Tujuan' (Destination) - NEVER dropdowns. Include a 'Tambah' (Add) button. After adding a route, PIC must select a transport option with a price associated with that option.
Step 5: Review Page. Must be a completely dedicated view/page before submission. Allows PIC to revise choices/prices.
Step 6: Proof Upload. During review or finalization, the PIC MUST upload proof ('bukti') for EACH selected item (Outbound ticket, Return ticket, Hotel, every Transport route).
technical_rules: Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects; use Shadcn UI customized to the theme.
Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
Include data-testid attributes on EVERY button, input, and interactive element.
Use Framer Motion to animate the transitions between the stepper views.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with subtle z-index hierarchy, but avoid muddy drop shadows.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Never center-align the main app container text. Keep natural left-to-right reading flow.
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with interaction animations (hover/active states).
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons. Use proper icon libraries like lucide-react.
Ensure generous padding inside form containers (e.g., p-8) so fields don't feel cramped.
